question: In the year 2021, Neeraj Chopra won India's first ever gold medal in athletics at the ________ Olympics.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tokyo**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Neeraj Chopra won India's first-ever gold medal in athletics at the **Tokyo Olympics** in **2021**.
 
• He competed in the javelin throw event and secured the gold medal with a throw of **87.58 meters**.
